changelog:
Settings areas stay directly accessible: compact rounded tabs now use a subtle theme-aware selection and a clear indicator, separate from TV focus.
Choice settings show the current readable selection below the title, without repeating identical values or hiding setup and safety notes.
Slider titles and explanations have more space; current values and ranges are aligned above a larger accessible slider target.
Preserved native settings persistence, search across areas, large-font layouts and remote navigation.
message: Dev build v849 - Clearer settings tabs, choices and sliders
